{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRaV3VPB7j4589y5Kb8C","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load categories <csv>`, storing every category row of a file or none. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LedgerInit.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md |\n| Provides | ledger load categories |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected, ledger_errors.OperationalFailure |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger load categories <csv>` loads category records from a CSV file whose header is exactly `category,description`. The whole file is parsed and every row, every duplicate key and every rule is checked before the first write, so a rejected file stores nothing.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Header: must equal `category,description` in names and order; otherwise exit 3 before any row is stored.\n- Each row: `category` is a code (1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`); `description` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline. A bad row rejects the file with exit 3.\n- Duplicate `category` values inside the file, or equal to a stored category, reject the file with exit 3.\n- An unreadable or missing file exits 1.\n- Success writes CSV `table,loaded` then `categories,<rows>` where `<rows>` is the number of rows loaded. Exit 0.\n- All inserts happen in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-001` — write: create a category - supplies: `category`, `description` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: get a category to detect a stored duplicate - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-categories-success ===\nIntent: A valid categories file stores every row, reports the loaded count, and the rows read back.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nrows = [[\"ZLC1A\", \"First loaded\"], [\"ZLC1B\", \"Second loaded\"], [\"ZLC1C\", \"Third loaded\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.categories.list())\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"cats.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows([[\"category\", \"description\"]] + rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(rows))]]\n    for c, desc in rows:\n        got = db.categories.get(category=c)\n        assert got is not None and got.description == desc\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before + len(rows)\n=== END AC load-categories-success ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-header-mismatch ===\nIntent: A file whose header differs in name or order is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_value = \"ZLC2A\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.categories.list())\n    for header in ([\"description\", \"category\"], [\"category\", \"name\"], [\"category\"]):\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"cats.csv\")\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n                w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n                w.writerow(header)\n                w.writerow([code_value, \"Header test\"][: len(header)])\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n        print(code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.categories.get(category=code_value) is None\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-categories-header-mismatch ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-bad-row-atomic ===\nIntent: A file with an invalid row anywhere is rejected with exit 3 and none of its valid rows are stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [[\"ZLC3A\", \"Good one\"], [\"ZLC3B\", \"Good two\"]]\nbad_rows = [\n    [\"zlc3c\", \"Lowercase code\"],\n    [\"ZLC3D\" + \"X\" * 8, \"Code too long\"],\n    [\"ZLC3E\", \"\"],\n    [\"ZLC3F\", \"D\" * 41],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.categories.list())\n    for bad in bad_rows:\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"cats.csv\")\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n                csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(\n                    [[\"category\", \"description\"]] + good + [bad]\n                )\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n        print(code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        for c, _ in good:\n            assert db.categories.get(category=c) is None\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-categories-bad-row-atomic ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-duplicates ===\nIntent: A duplicate key inside the file or against a stored category rejects the file with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nstored = \"ZLC4S\"\nfresh = \"ZLC4N\"\nstored_desc = \"Already stored\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.categories.create(category=stored, description=stored_desc)\n    before = len(db.categories.list())\n    cases = [\n        [[fresh, \"One\"], [fresh, \"Two\"]],\n        [[fresh, \"One\"], [stored, \"Replacement\"]],\n    ]\n    for rows in cases:\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"cats.csv\")\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n                csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(\n                    [[\"category\", \"description\"]] + rows\n                )\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n        print(code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.categories.get(category=fresh) is None\n        assert db.categories.get(category=stored).description == stored_desc\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-categories-duplicates ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-unreadable-file ===\nIntent: A missing file exits 1 with nothing on standard output and no change.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.categories.list())\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        missing = os.path.join(d, \"absent.csv\")\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", missing)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-categories-unreadable-file ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No row is stored when any row, header or duplicate check fails.\n- Application code does not open a database driver and does not read `sources/` files.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only and never include a DSN or credential.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with row validation and the final-balance rule, all or nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.parse_amount, validation.parse_date, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, balance_rules.check_final_balances, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` loads transaction records from a file whose header is exactly `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`. Each loaded transaction keeps the `txn_id` from its file. The whole file is validated before the first write.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Header must match exactly in names and order; otherwise exit 3 with no write.\n- Each row is validated: `txn_id` is an integer, `date` a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`, `account` and `category` valid codes that exist (stored rows), `amount` matching `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]` with at most two decimals and never zero (parsed to integer cents, no floating point), `memo` 0 to 60 characters without comma or newline.\n- A `txn_id` repeated in the file or already stored rejects the file.\n- The negative-balance rule is judged on each account's final balance after the whole file (stored balance plus all file amounts). An intermediate dip restored by a later row of the same file is accepted.\n- Any failure exits 3 (unknown account or category, bad row, duplicate id, negative final balance), writes nothing to standard output and stores nothing.\n- A header-only file loads zero rows and writes `table,loaded` then `transactions,0`.\n- Success writes `table,loaded` then `transactions,<rows>`. Validation, the balance check and all inserts run in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: get a transaction to detect a stored duplicate id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list an account's transactions for its stored balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm an account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm a category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-txn-success-keeps-ids ===\nIntent: A valid file stores each row with its file txn_id and integer-cent amount, and reports the loaded count.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZLT1A\", \"ZLT1C\"\nrows = [\n    [\"910001\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"first\"],\n    [\"910002\", \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"-25.50\", \"second\"],\n    [\"910003\", \"2026-05-03\", acct, cat, \"7.05\", \"\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load txn\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load txn\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(\n                [[\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]] + rows\n            )\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\n    for r in rows:\n        got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(r[0]))\n        assert got is not None\n        cents = int(Decimal(r[4]) * 100)\n        assert (got.date, got.account, got.category, got.amount, got.memo) == (r[1], acct, cat, cents, r[5])\n        assert isinstance(got.amount, int)\n=== END AC load-txn-success-keeps-ids ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-header-only ===\nIntent: A file holding only its header loads zero rows and reports transactions,0.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow(\n                [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n            )\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"0\"]]\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-txn-header-only ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-unknown-reference-atomic ===\nIntent: An unknown account or category rejects the whole file with exit 3 and stores none of its rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZLT3A\", \"ZLT3C\"\nghost_acct, ghost_cat = \"ZLT3NOA\", \"ZLT3NOC\"\ngood = [[\"910011\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok1\"], [\"910012\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok2\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Ref test\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Ref test\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    bad_rows = [\n        [\"910013\", \"2026-05-01\", ghost_acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"no account\"],\n        [\"910013\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, ghost_cat, \"10.00\", \"no category\"],\n    ]\n    for bad in bad_rows:\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"t.csv\")\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n                csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(\n                    [[\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]] + good + [bad]\n                )\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n        print(code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        for r in good:\n            assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(r[0])) is None\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC load-txn-unknown-reference-atomic ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-bad-field-rejected ===\nIntent: Zero or over-precise amounts, impossible dates and invalid ids each reject the file with exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZLT4A\", \"ZLT4C\"\nbad_variants = [\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"0.00\", \"zero\"],\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"0\", \"zero\"],\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"-0\", \"zero\"],\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"precision\"],\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \".50\", \"no leading digit\"],\n    [\"910021\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"+5.00\", [[str(fresh_id), \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"a\"], [str(stored_id), \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"b\"]],\n    ]\n    for rows in cases:\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows([header] + rows)\n        return cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Balance test\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Balance test\")\n\n    negative = [\n        [\"910041\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"50.00\", \"in\"],\n        [\"910042\", \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"-50.01\", \"too much out\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, err = run(negative)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910041) is None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910042) is None\n\n    dip_restored = [\n        [\"910043\", \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"-100.00\", \"dip first\"],\n        [\"910044\", \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"200.00\", \"restore\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, err = run(dip_restored)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910043).amount == -10000\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910044).amount == 20000\n\n    over_stored = [[\"910045\", \"2026-05-03\", acct, cat, \"-100.01\", \"past the stored balance\"]]\n    code, out, err = run(over_stored)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910045) is None\n\n    within_stored = [[\"910046\", \"2026-05-03\", acct, cat, \"-100.00\", \"exactly to zero\"]]\n load-txn-final-balance-rule ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-seed-workflow ===\nIntent: After init, the supplied seed files load in order, report their loaded counts, the rejected bad file changes nothing, and counts persist across invocations.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\ndef data_rows(path):\n    with open(path, newline=\"\") as f:\n        return len(list(csv.reader(f))) - 1\n\n\nn_accounts = data_rows(\"sources/seed_accounts.csv\")\nn_categories = data_rows(\"sources/seed_categories.csv\")\nn_txns = data_rows(\"sources/seed_transactions.csv\")\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n\n    for table, path, n in (\n        (\"accounts\", \"sources/seed_accounts.csv\", n_accounts),\n        (\"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\", n_categories),\n        (\"transactions\", \"sources/seed_transactions.csv\", n_txns),\n    ):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", table, path)\n        print(code, out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(n)]]\n\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", \"sources/seed_transactions_bad.csv\")\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n    assert len(db.accounts.list()) == n_accounts\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == n_categories\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == n_txns\n=== END AC load-txn-seed-workflow any layer.\n- Application code never reads `sources/` seed files; they reach the database only through `ledger load`.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only and never include a DSN or credential.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountAdd.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>` stores a new account and prints its row.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Arguments: exactly a code and a code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-success ===\nIntent: Adding an account prints its zero-activity row and the account reads back from the store.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_value = \"ZAA1A\"\nname = \"Added Account\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code_value) is None\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_value, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [\n        [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"],\n        [code_value, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"],\n    ]\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code_value)\n    assert got is not None and got.name == name\n=== END AC account-add-success ===\n\n=== AC account-add-duplicate-code ===\nIntent: A duplicate code exits 3, \"Original Name\"\nother = \"Different Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code_value, name=original)\n    before = len(db.accounts.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_value, other)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code_value).name == original\n    assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n=== END AC account-add-duplicate-code ===\n\n=== AC account-add-repeated-name ===\nIntent: Two accounts with different codes may share one name.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nshared = \"Shared Name\"\nfirst, second = \"ZAA3A\", \"ZAA3B\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", first, shared)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", second, shared)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=first).name == shared\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=second).name == shared\n=== END AC account-add-repeated-name ===\n\n=== AC (\"zaa4a\", \"Lowercase code\"),\n    (\"ZAA-4\", \"Punctuation in code\"),\n    (\"Z\" * 13, \"Code too long\"),\n    (\"ZAA4B\", \"\"),\n    (\"ZAA4C\", \"N\" * 41),\n    (\"ZAA4D\", decimals, a leading `-` when negative, and `0.00` for zero.\n- An absent code exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: get an account by 325]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=name)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get test\")\n    for i, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n acct)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    balance = f\"{Decimal(sum(amounts)).scaleb(-2):.2f}\"\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [\n        [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"],\n        [acct, name, str(len(amounts)), balance],\n    ]\n=== END AC account-get-with-activity ===\n\n=== AC account-get-no-activity ===\nIntent: An account without Account\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=name)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", acct)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [\n        [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"],\n        [acct, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"],\n    ]\n=== END AC account-get-no-activity ===\n\n=== \"ZAG5A\", \"extra\")):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    print(args, code, out, err)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC account-get-wrong-argument-count ===\n\n## storing every category row of a file or none. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LedgerInit.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md |\n| Provides | ledger load categories |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected, ledger_errors.OperationalFailure |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger load categories <csv>` loads category records from a CSV file whose header is exactly `category,description`. The whole file is parsed and every row, every duplicate key and every rule is checked before the first write, so a rejected file stores nothing.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Header: must equal `category,description` in names and order; otherwise exit 3 before any row is stored.\n- Each row: `category` is a code (1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`); `description` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline. A bad row rejects the file with exit 3.\n- Duplicate `category` values inside the file, or equal to a stored category, reject the file with exit 3.\n- An unreadable or missing file exits 1.\n- Success writes CSV `table,loaded` then `categories,<rows>` where `<rows>` is the number of rows loaded. Exit 0.\n- All inserts happen in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-001` — write: create a category - supplies: `category`, `description` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: get a category to detect a stored duplicate - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC before = len(db.categories.list())\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"cats.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows([[\"category\", \"description\"]] + rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(rows))]]\n    for c, desc in rows:\n        got = db.categories.get(category=c)\n        assert got is not None and got.description == desc\n    assert len(db.categories.list()) == before + len(rows)\n=== END AC load-categories-success ===\n\n=== AC FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with row validation and the final-balance rule, all or nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.parse_amount, validation.parse_date, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, balance_rules.check_final_balances, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` loads transaction records from a file whose header is exactly `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`. Each loaded transaction keeps the `txn_id` from its file. The whole file is validated before the first write.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Header must match exactly in names and order; otherwise exit 3 with no write.\n- Each row is validated: `txn_id` is an integer, `date` a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`, `account` and `category` valid codes that exist (stored rows), `amount` matching `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]` with at most two decimals and never zero (parsed to integer cents, no floating point), `memo` 0 to 60 characters without comma or newline.\n- A `txn_id` repeated in the file or already stored rejects the file.\n- The negative-balance rule is judged on each account's final balance after the whole file (stored balance plus all file amounts). An intermediate dip restored by a later row of the same file is accepted.\n- Any failure exits 3 (unknown account or category, bad row, duplicate id, negative final balance), writes nothing to standard output and stores nothing.\n- A header-only file loads zero rows and writes `table,loaded` then `transactions,0`.\n- Success writes `table,loaded` then `transactions,<rows>`. Validation, the balance check and all inserts run in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: get a transaction to detect a stored duplicate id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list an account's transactions for its stored balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm an account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm a category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n\n## Programmatic db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load txn\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load txn\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(\n                [[\"txn_id\", \"date\",
